about_the_game:
Localization:

This game has been localized in both English and Turkish; players can experience the story and atmosphere in their preferred language.----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Special Cinematics:

These cinematics are inspired by period-specific TV shows and commercials. Each one has been carefully crafted with English voice acting. Subtitles are available for Turkish players. Some cinematics are connected to gameplay, while others provide deeper insights into the story.----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

References:

All objects, assets, and inspirations used in Vesper Hotel that require attribution are listed on the external references page shared in our Privacy Policy section. This page provides proper attribution for all materials used.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Game Experience:

Prepare for an atmospheric experience where horror and mystery intertwine. Vesper Hotel invites players to uncover the truth in eerie corridors, abandoned rooms, and locations carrying traces of a dark past. Every corner is filled with uncertainty, every room will challenge you with its own story. Sometimes you'll have only a faint light source, other times your greatest enemy will be your own fears.

FEATURES:

  • First-person horror experience: Play through the eyes of the character and feel tension at its highest level.

  • Atmospheric exploration: Solve the dark history of the hotel yourself through notes, reports, and environmental details.

  • Psychological thriller: Not only enemies hiding in the shadows, but your own mind will play tricks on you.

  • Independent development spirit: A carefully crafted horror adventure developed entirely by a single person.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

name: Vesper Hotel

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel i5-4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Even if your system meets the requirements, you may experience small variations in performance, such as 5–10 FPS difference.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5700 XT / NVIDIA RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Even if your system meets the requirements, you may experience small variations in performance, such as 5–10 FPS difference.

short_description: Explore an abandoned hotel where forgotten rooms hide unsettling memories and shadows whisper of the past. In Vesper Hotel, every step deeper into the halls becomes a struggle for survival against both fear and your own sanity.
